Context: mid-market product team building a relevance layer for their marketplace search. Primary path: Hosted API trial -> short POC -> Dedicated reserved capacity if performance/price hit targets. Use-case details: reranking of candidate lists produced by a fast embedding+bm25 generator; want a rerank endpoint that takes list of candidates and returns stable scores + top-k sorted results. Latency/throughput targets: target <=60ms p95 for rerank single-request (top-10) in production; throughputs expected 50-250 QPS during peak; willing to accept batch offline scoring for nightly re-rank tasks. Model preferences: open models preferred (Llama2/Mistral variants) but want Redwood to validate quantized variants. Must support model fallbacks (smaller model for degradation). Evaluation: they provided labeled eval set (~100k pairs, NDCG/Recall metrics), want Redwood to run offline scoring and return per-query metrics and calibrated scores. Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 proof, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for portion of dataset.
